notes.title: Story Rework Update 2.0!
notes.notes:
Story, a year ago was not the game you - player deserved to play, so I decided to rework it into a much better experience.
Changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38080891/f4c31f0758a2ec70a58ec7fa426a80a2d3a5fac6.png
Almost every aspect of the game was reworked, so you may not see many similarities with the previous version but the core of the gameplay which is exploration and player-driven narrative, stays in its' place. There's also a new Golden Gang supporter skin if you would like to help me a little.
Visuals
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38080891/8ff147a526dd1ce04a66d85d167a9d0097b33693.png
All visual elements from the game were designed again with new art direction in mind and much improved readability.
Combat
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38080891/f012e7e96d903f53db58d2a402f396f9bdcfbd8a.gif

New, more responsive animations
Much better AI
Completely new companion system
And much more left for you to discover!

What's Next?
Today, only the first chapter of Story 2.0 was released. I wanted to release it that way, because I wanted to hear your  feedback and address it in upcoming updates. If you would like to share any thoughts on Story, do it here or on our Discord channel here.

Regards,
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38080891/e2db29cfc7368ab4e522e2a3d6b99d21c0cdb430.png

notes.title: Story Update 1.1!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Thanks for playing Story! Huge thanks to the first Golden Gang member! 

First of all, let's have look at statistics:


40,697 copies of Story in your libraries
342 unique players
22 average daily players
1 GOLDEN GANG MEMBER


It looks like we are going forward and reaching bigger audience. Thanks for giving my game a shot :D

Changelog 1.1

Story 1.1 is quite different from version released month ago. I tried to improve every aspect of it based on your great feedback and keep it soul as it was. It was quite a lot of work for me and I the only thought I have on my mind is sleep. Here's list of the changes:

[olist]
Added FULL gamepad support
Improved camera
Reworked combat (everyone dies from one hit)
Added a plenty of new enemies
Added save points 
Added system of essences which makes gameplay more interesting and fun
Reworked almost all animations
Increased speed of all characters
Added small tutorial
Decreased strength of volumetric fog effect
Geometry will not cover your character any more
Removed ability to speed up time flow 
And a lot more smaller tweaks!
[/olist]


What's next?

As I said, I'd like to implement multiplayer to Story - both PvE and PvP, more overall content but I cannot tell if it will happen in the nearest future because earning 5$ in the first month is quite disappointing and it will not allow me to work on Story full-time for the next months, so I've got to find different day-time job than developing Story and maybe work on it in my spare time. 

I hope you will have a great time with Story 1.1
